requirements.observations: All elevations show evenly spaced trapezoidal crests along the shaft. Both isometrics confirm one continuous right-handed helical ridge with normal lead transitions, a beveled tip, and no detached or merged thread segments.

All ten views show one connected leveling foot: a centered threaded shaft overlaps a broad 40 mm eight-sided, 18 mm-tall side-access thumbwheel, the bottom is uninterrupted and flat, the upper wheel edge is chamfered, and the thread tip is beveled. Opposing views agree with no clipping or stray geometry.

views.observations: Centered threaded shaft, uniform pitch, connected 18 mm-tall eight-sided thumbwheel, and beveled tip are clearly visible.
Rear elevation shows the expected helical lead transitions while preserving a continuous shaft core and pad joint.
Left elevation confirms uniform thread depth, full pad width, and a clean connected root.
Right elevation agrees with the left and shows no missing crests or unintended gaps.
Top view shows a centered shaft within the regular eight-sided 40 mm thumbwheel.
Bottom view shows one broad, uninterrupted, flat eight-sided contact face.
Front isometric resolves the hand pad chamfer, shaft overlap, continuous helix, and beveled tip.
Rear isometric confirms the same connected body and normal helical start/end transitions.
Underside front isometric confirms the broad uninterrupted contact face and continuous pad-to-shaft joint.
Opposing underside view confirms the same flat contact face without holes, fragments, or clipping.
